title: A class member declared twice passes the checker.
text: `nvs check` reports no error for a class that declares the same member twice. Two methods named `f`, or two `constructor` methods, stop at `E0901` when cranelift sees a duplicate definition. Two properties named `$x` compile, and with two different types the program exits with status 5 and prints nothing. A property declared in the class body and again as a promoted constructor parameter compiles, and the promoted value is the one read. Locals have `E0406` for a second declaration; a class member has no such check. It closes when a second declaration of a property, a method or a constructor in one class is a diagnostic at the second one, with a conformance case for each form.
